steps: Set the interfaces: upright 2x M5 (40 mm apart horizontally, centres 35 mm above the plate) from R05 (user) and R06 (IMG-01). Base 4x M6 in a 2x2 pattern that the bracket defines (R04, R12, A02).
Size the envelope: width 70 x base length 75 x upright height 50 mm, all within 80 mm (R11).
Set the thickness to 6 mm and the inner bend radius to 4 mm. Check them against DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN, DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN and DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET.
Set ISO 273 medium clearance holes: M6 -> 6.6 mm, M5 -> 5.5 mm. Check hole-to-free-edge distance >= 1.5 x d (GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE).
Hand calculation: F = 2 kg x 9.81 x 3 = 58.9 N downward at 40 mm from the upright outer face. Check bending at the upright root and the base-bolt tension against 276/2 = 138 MPa allowable.
Build the model in Fusion 360 and measure the bounding box, hole positions and diameters, thickness and fillet. Compare them with the expected geometry.
Report the results as concept-level only (A01). Make no safety or compliance claim.

leg_base_length.rationale: Second base row at x=60 plus a 15 mm end margin (>= 9.9 mm required). Fits within the 80 mm envelope.

leg_upright_height.rationale: M5 row at z=35 plus a 15 mm top margin (>= 8.25 mm required). Within 80 mm.

bracket_width.rationale: Gives 15 mm edge margin for the M5 holes at y=+/-20 and 12 mm for the M6 holes at y=+/-23. Within 80 mm.

bracket_thickness.rationale: Strength alone needs about 1.2 mm (root bending). 6 mm is chosen for stiffness and bolt-head seating. Satisfies the 2.0 mm minimum wall.

bend_inner_radius.rationale: 4 mm meets R >= 3.0 for end-mill access and >= 0.2 x 6 = 1.2 mm for the fatigue fillet rule.

base_hole_x0.rationale: The fillet ends at x=10. At x=20, an M6 socket head (dia 10) clears the fillet and the upright for tool access.

base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: A wide row spread increases the resisting arm against overturning by the upright moment. The last row sits at x=60.

base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Holes at y=+/-23 give 12 mm to the side edges (>= 9.9 mm) in the 70 mm width.

upright_hole_z0.rationale: The user states the hole centres are 35 mm above the flat plate (= base bottom face, z=0).

upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Not used: there is a single upright row (R05: two holes on one horizontal line).

upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: The user states the holes are 40 mm apart horizontally. The IMG-01 sketch shows the same 40 mm.

base_hole_rows.rationale: Four M6 bolts in a rectangular 2x2 pattern.

base_hole_cols.rationale: Four M6 bolts in a rectangular 2x2 pattern.

upright_hole_rows.rationale: The two M5 holes lie on one horizontal line.

design_inputs.base_mates_with: Horizontal flat plate (undrilled; to be drilled to the bracket's 2x2 M6 pattern, R12)
design_inputs.upright_mates_with: 2 kg sensor box, 2x M5 at 40 mm horizontal pitch, centres 35 mm above plate (R05, IMG-01)

load_case.description: Sensor box weight x dynamic factor 3, acting downward at the centre of mass. The centre of mass is 40 mm out from the upright outer face (x=-40), centred between the M5 holes (A03). The load bends the upright root and puts tension in the front base bolts. Allowable = 276 MPa / 2.

verification_plan: Fusion measurement: bounding box <= 80 x 80 x 80 mm (expected 75 x 70 x 50) (R11).
Fusion measurement: thickness 6 mm, inner bend radius 4 mm, outer radius 10 mm.
Fusion measurement: hole diameters 6.6 / 5.5 mm. Base hole centres at x=20/60, y=+/-23. Upright hole centres at z=35, y=+/-20 (R05, R06).
Rule check: DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN, DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN, DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET, STD-ISO273-MEDIUM, GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE (minimum edge margins 12 mm for M6 and 15 mm for M5).
Hand calculation (Python): upright root bending sigma = 6*F*40/(b*t^2) vs 138 MPa. Also check at the M5 hole line with the net width reduced by the holes.
Hand calculation (Python): base bolt tension from the overturning moment about the rear row, compared with an M6 indicative capacity. Report as concept-level only (A01).

new_assumptions.text: Leg thickness is set to 6 mm. This is well above the about 1.2 mm strength minimum, for stiffness and bolt-head/nut seating.
new_assumptions.rationale: A thin aluminium leg under 3 g dynamic load may deflect or vibrate. The user gave no stiffness or frequency target.
new_assumptions.impact: Adds mass. A lighter section can be re-checked if a mass target is given.

new_assumptions.text: The base 2x2 M6 pattern is set at x=20/60 mm and y=+/-23 mm from the upright outer face and the centreline.
new_assumptions.rationale: The first row clears the bend fillet for socket-head access. The wide row spacing gives a resisting arm against the overturning moment, and the pattern stays within the 80 mm envelope.
new_assumptions.impact: The plate must be drilled to this pattern (R12).
